entities.label: Timeframe
entities.summary: Stentinello culture was a middle Neolithic culture, widespread in Sicily and Calabria, dated to the fifth millennium BC. Under different names this culture is also present in the Aeolian islands and Malta. Kronio culture, a variant of that of Stentinello was widespread in western Sicily.
